title: Quarterly OKR alignment: Private/VPC capacity runway & upgrade guardrails
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective: Produce a repeatable quarterly runbook and roadmap slice that ties Private/VPC capacity budgeting, upgrade windows, and rollout guardrails directly to team OKRs.

Scope:
- Define capacity runway thresholds (green/amber/red) for Dedicated/Private clusters tied to cost and latency OKRs.
- Produce upgrade guardrail checklist for zero-downtime kernel/agent upgrades across private fleets.
- Create OKR -> initiative mapping so each engineering milestone maps to measurable signals (SLO burn, cost per 1M tokens, onboarding time).
- Identify required telemetry and dashboards to measure success signals in Console and Observability.

Success criteria (measurable):
- Documented capacity thresholds and automated alerts in Console for 3 customer cohorts (small, mid, enterprise).
- Runbook validated in 2 staging upgrades with <1% error budget impact and rollback time <15 minutes.
- OKR mapping artifact accepted by Eng, SRE, and Sales enablement; all linked PRDs and runbooks in Confluence.

Stakeholders: Product (Aisha K), Eng (Marco A, Priya N), SRE (Jonah L), Solutions (Ruth C), GTM/Customer Success (David M).

Constraints & trade-offs:
- Short timeline for Q1 means prioritizing monitoring and guardrails over full automation of capacity scaling.
- Some telemetry depends on runtime-1.19 agent metrics; plan includes temporary instrumentation if runtime release slips.

Out-of-scope:
- Large-surface UX redesign of Console dashboards (we will produce focused dashboard panels only).

Deliverables:
1) Capacity runway thresholds doc + alert rules (Confluence + Console alerts IDs).
2) Upgrade guardrail checklist + canary criteria for private fleets.
3) OKR -> initiative mapping spreadsheet and linked PRD.
4) Telemetry dashboard panels and a short playbook for on-call responders.

Risks:
- Instrumentation gaps in older customer agents causing blind spots. Mitigation: list customers needing agent update and include them in rollout waves.
- Cost estimation uncertainty for unknown customer workloads. Mitigation: define conservative budgets and a safety multiplier for first two quarters.
